description: End-to-end applied AI/ML research pipeline. Takes a research question and dataset, runs literature review, multi-method classification/regression analysis with parallel model tracks, and produces a complete manuscript (Markdown + LaTeX/PDF). Use when user says "application pipeline", "applied analysis", "analyze my data and write paper", "end-to-end analysis", or wants to go from raw data to manuscript. Covers all data modalities: NLP text, structured/tabular, and image data.
